title: KCI Commuter Train Driving Simulator
customer: PT Kereta Commuter Indonesia (PT KCI / PT KAI)
summary: Clean-sheet civilian transit driving simulator developed for PT Kereta Commuter Indonesia (KCI) in a record 12-month turnaround, featuring parametric railway track authoring, Russian rolling stock dynamics integration, and Redis state distribution.
highlights: Pioneered entry into civilian rail simulation following military defense contracts, delivered in a record 1-year timeframe.
Integrated specialized Russian train dynamics software with 100% in-house physical hardware cabs, visual displays, and CommSystem audio.
Engineered custom web-based Railway Editor generating parametric, georeferenced rail splines (curvature, banking, micro-vibrations) over surveyed terrain.
Architected lightweight Redis in-memory backend for low-latency track geometry and train telemetry distribution along the route.
